description: Researchers at the State Key Laboratory of Green Building and partner institutions publish two scripts for constructing typical and future meteorological years. The February 2026 deposit supplies a Python TMY generator, a MATLAB FMY generator, requirements and a README. Historical hourly observations or downscaled climate projections are transformed into 8,760-record weather years for building and environmental simulations, with documented CSV and EPW output options. Coverage depends on the user’s stations and scenario inputs; example scenarios include SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0, whereas the supplied LICENSE and README specify MIT for the software. Both allow free access, but the version-specific licence discrepancy is preserved. Related catalogue record model-energyplus is one stated output consumer. Statistical selection details, input completeness and climate uncertainty remain unverified. The documentation includes an unfinished citation placeholder; scripts were not executed.
